scenarios.details: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-cross-lane-panic-burst-2026-05-13.spec.js passed: Spark Pod recorded damage across multiple lanes while Briar Pod remained lane-restricted.

scenarios.name: Spark Pod wave-3 canonical detonation under the real scripted timeline
scenarios.details: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-wave3-canonical-detonation-2026-05-13.spec.js passed: started the real challenge scenario, fast-forwarded to wave 3 (52000ms), placed Spark Pod at the canonical (row 2, col 3) tile, and observed a trap-type splash event whose damage events span the Pod's own lane (2) and the adjacent lane (3) — the synchronized two-lane Spore Tick swarms scripted by wave 3 of 2026-05-13. This is a mechanic-isolation slice; the full-clear evidence is in the next scenario.

scenarios.name: Spark Drill canonical full clear under intended economy
scenarios.details: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-canonical-full-clear-2026-05-13.spec.js passed: plays the real four-wave Spark Drill challenge from t=0 under intended economy (startingResources:110, resourcePerTick:18, gardenHealth:2) with NO HP override, NO resource grants, NO timeline suppression, and NO finishScenario(). The canonical 10-placement plan (SP r2 c5 → SR → PP r4 c1 → PP r0 c1 → TV r2 c0 → CM r1 c1 → SP r3 c3 → PP r3 c1 → PP r2 c1 → TV r3 c0; 800 sap total against ~838 sap income by t=84s) reaches scenarioPhase="endless" and Spark Pod detonates during the clear. Both Spark Pods are load-bearing on the cross-lane property: wave-1 lane-2 sporetick swarm needs SP's 117 px radius (BP's 36 px catches only 3 of 5), and wave-3 two-lane cross needs SP's cross-lane splash (BP same-lane leaves the off-lane swarm untouched). Proves the board is hard-but-winnable at shipped numbers and that Spark Pod is used in the actual winning line.

scenarios.name: Spark Drill tutorial → challenge → endless gating with Spark Pod roster
scenarios.details: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-tutorial-challenge-endless-gating-2026-05-13.spec.js (first test) passed: new-visitor title scene exposes "Tutorial First" as primary CTA, hides "Endless Unlocked", and reports state.endlessUnlocked === false. Tutorial wave 1 restricts the inventory to {amberWall, thornVine, sparkPod} while keeping the full Spark Drill roster rendered with non-subset chips visibly locked. Tutorial → challenge handoff via finishScenario() promotes mode to "challenge" with the full {sparkPod, briarPod, pollenPuff, cottonburrMortar, thornVine, amberWall, sunrootBloom} roster and a DOM "Spark Pod" inventory chip exposing a 100-sap aria-label. The canonical 10-placement plan is attempted, a live Spark Pod defender is confirmed on the board, and finishScenario() then flips challengeCleared false → true and scenarioPhase → "endless". The title scene afterward surfaces "Endless Unlocked" and state.endlessUnlocked === true. End-to-end gating verified.

scenarios.name: Spark Drill roster-expansion proof — May 6 roster (no Spark Pod) does NOT clear
scenarios.details: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-tutorial-challenge-endless-gating-2026-05-13.spec.js (second test) passed: starts the May 13 challenge under shipped intended economy (startingResources:110, resourcePerTick:18, gardenHealth:2), overrides the live availablePlants to the May 6 Brood Watch roster (the prior dated challenge; no sparkPod), and attempts the SAME canonical 10-placement plan with sparkPod → briarPod substituted at both SP slots. The run does NOT reach scenarioPhase === "endless" — game over fires in wave 1 at t ≈ 13.5 s when the BP at r2 c5 (36 px same-lane splash radius) catches only the first 3 of the 5-tick lane-2 Spore Tick swarm. The trailing two ticks breach (gardenHealth:2 → 0). This is the AC-19-style roster-expansion proof that Spark Pod is required for the May 13 board: the previous dated challenge roster cannot clear it under the same canonical-plan placements.

scenarios.name: Offline scenario-difficulty validator on Spark Drill (validator limitation)
scenarios.details: Skipped: npm run validate:scenario-difficulty -- --date 2026-05-13 returns ok:false, but the same offline beam search also returns ok:false for 2026-04-28 (Snap Garden) and 2026-05-06 (Brood Watch) — both shipped boards. This is a known limitation of the beam-search heuristic on multi-wave dated boards. The runtime Playwright suite supersedes it: tests/uiux/game-spark-pod-canonical-full-clear-2026-05-13.spec.js plays the full scripted challenge under intended economy with no overrides and reaches challenge clear with Spark Pod detonating.
